title: 取色色卡
method: Read each rectangle's visible Figma Design inspector after selecting it on the canvas; validate its X/Y/width/height against the color-card grid. No screenshot pixel sampling or color generation.
notes: Column headings are recorded as written. Hue interpretation is inferred from their arrangement; row usage/semantic token bindings were not defined by the visible inspector.
C1-C6 are source row identifiers, not confirmed light/dark mode roles. Do not assign semantic roles based only on brightness.
Rows C6 and C5 are preserved in their original canvas order, not renumbered.
Columns 0 and 360 are not identical in C4 and C5; preserve their original values instead of deduplicating or regenerating them mathematically.
All recorded fills and layers are 100% opaque. The previously supplied 30%/50% UI overlay examples are separate composition rules, not alpha values on these source swatches.
No Figma content, sharing, published site or demo palette was changed. This is an extraction snapshot, not a declaration that the file is an approved final brand standard.
